scripts.build:clean: if [ -d dist ]; then mv dist "/tmp/build-dist-$(date +%s)"; fi
scripts.web-test:types: tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --jsx react-jsx --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node web-test/*.ts
scripts.web-test:clean: if [ -d test-results ]; then mv test-results "/tmp/web-test-results-$(date +%s)"; fi
scripts.web-test: pnpm web-test:clean && pnpm web-test:types && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
